newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar slips in steady dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar slips in steady dollar demand.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly weaker at 474.00/475.00 per dollar Tuesday compared to 473.00/474.00 per dollar Monday as demand for foreign currency was met by tight supply, traders said.
"The market was very tough with plenty of corporate demand and counter sales. Meanwhile there was no supply, so the exchange rate rose," one trader said.
Traders said the Central Bank was virtually the only seller on the market meaning that it could virtually set the exchange rate as it wished.
One trader said the Central Bank appeared to be moving the rate to end the year at about 475 bolivars per dollar.
